F-COIN-P30 13/50 intermittent; F-RACE-COUNTER 50/50 deterministic; F-NEVER-REPRO 0/50 not-reproduced; F-TIME-JITTER 9/50 intermittent; F-ALWAYS-RED 50/50 deterministic.

evidence.claim: Wilson and Clopper-Pearson intervals stored on each failure match an independent recompute from (k, n=50); a last-run-only report of the 6-red-then-green sequence is rejected (honest 1/7).

negative_controls.description: Drop outcome_vector from a failure row. The overlay must reject a k-of-n summary that is not backed by the full n=50 vector.
Six RED then one GREEN must be reported as 1/7 green, never as a last-run-only GREEN that discarded the six reds.
Re-draw with seed+1 must differ from the recorded sample, or the seed is inert.

discard_control.note: Last-run-only would report GREEN after 6 reds. Honest report is 6/7 reproduced (1/7 green). Discarding reds is a unit failure.

failures.reason: Calibrated Bernoulli flake (p~0.3) so the harness is shown to keep mixed RED/GREEN vectors instead of collapsing to the last run.
Unsynchronized counter under recorded concurrency; scheduling flake.
Suspected intermittent that does not reproduce (always GREEN).

report.question: For each baseline failure suspected of being intermittent, what is its reproduction FREQUENCY? Run it 50 times under the recorded conditions and report k of 50 with a binomial interval. A single green does not refute an intermittent failure and a single red does not establish a deterministic one; the deliverable is the rate, not a boolean.
